I have farmed this land since I was a boy, and I learned from my father how to grow maize. Last season I used the government fertilizer on this plot, so I will do it again this year because the cobs were big, and I will put one bag of NPK and one bag of urea on this field. I also have cow manure that I will spread, and I will plant the improved seed I kept from last year. I do not use chemicals for pests, and I have no irrigation, but I will hire young men for five days to help with the heavy digging because my old back cannot manage it alone, while my family works the other fifty days.
